symptom: marketplace update --no-baseline deleted an association another module owns into the updated module (MyFirstModule.Request_Configuration → WorkflowCommons.Configuration) without naming it; mx check then reported 0 errors, so nothing pointed at the loss.
cause: --no-baseline skipped the whole drift computation, and the dependent-association search (#1502) lived inside it, although it reads only the project and needs no baseline.
insight: **An opt-out flag should skip only the part it cannot do.** --no-baseline exists because the baseline package cannot be built; the cross-module association search does not use the baseline, so bundling it into the same branch made the flag silently drop a check it never had a reason to drop. Split each safety check by its inputs before deciding which flag disables it.
